_comment: When an agent's console counts as waiting on an answer. The frontend (awaitingInput.ts) reads it
for the attention model, Rust (agents/awaiting_input.rs) for a supervisor's await_result with
untilInput. Both compile these patterns, case-insensitive, and test the last scannedLines clean lines:
\r normalised to \n, ANSI removed, whitespace collapsed, trimmed, lines without a letter or digit
dropped. A bare question mark never counts: agents narrate questions in prose all the time.
